name: Vampire - Unarmed Strike - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a legendary

results.text: The enemy twists away at the last moment, his claws finding only empty air.
A desperate lunge misses its mark, his fangs clattering against cold steel instead.
His strike is met with a shield of light, searing his unholy flesh on contact.
The enemy's reflexes betray his age as they dodge the vampire's deadly blow.
His claws swipe through smoke and shadow, finding no target to rend.
